system.description:
FOCUS TECHNIQUE Action 2 AP

You heighten your senses for 1 minute. You gain Nightvision, allowing you to see in dim light as though it were bright light, and you ignore concealment caused by dim light.

GREATER MASTERY At 8th level, the duration increases to 10 minutes.

At 12th level, you gain Darkvision rather than Nightvision for the duration.

Automated: press Use: 2 AP and this use. You gain Nightvision for 1 minute; for 10 minutes from 8th level, and Darkvision instead from 12th.
